stories.headline: Iran war strains UK-US relations as Starmer pursues closer EU ties amid Trump criticism
stories.summary: Prime Minister Starmer faces mounting pressure from President Trump over UK's limited support for the Iran war, leading Starmer to announce closer economic and defense ties with the EU. Trump has repeatedly mocked Starmer's leadership and threatened NATO withdrawal over European allies' reluctance to support the conflict.

stories.headline: King Charles's US state visit proceeds despite Iran war tensions and Epstein controversy
stories.summary: King Charles will travel to Washington later this month for his first state visit as monarch to mark America's 250th anniversary, despite calls for delay over the Iran war and pressure from Jeffrey Epstein victims to meet survivors. The visit aims to strengthen UK-US relations amid current tensions.

stories.headline: Starmer condemns Kanye West Wireless Festival booking as sponsors withdraw over antisemitism
stories.summary: Prime Minister Starmer criticized the Wireless Festival for booking Kanye West despite his history of antisemitic remarks, calling it 'deeply concerning.' Major sponsors Pepsi and Diageo subsequently withdrew their support for the festival following the backlash.

articles.title: Kanye West: Pepsi withdraws as Wireless Festival sponsor after backlash

stories.headline: Bank of England warns Iran war could force 1.3 million more households into higher mortgage costs
stories.summary: The Bank of England issued warnings that the Iran conflict represents a 'substantial negative supply shock' to the global economy, potentially increasing mortgage payments for an additional 1.3 million UK households by late 2028. Governor Bailey cautioned against market expectations of aggressive rate hikes.

stories.headline: Kemi Badenoch leads Conservative campaign focusing on potholes and energy policy
stories.summary: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch launched her party's local election campaign with a £112 million 'pothole patrol' plan and pledged to scrap carbon taxes to reduce energy bills. Despite challenging polls, Badenoch has emerged as the most popular party leader and ruled out coalitions with Reform UK.

stories.headline: Nigel Farage commits Reform UK to pension triple lock while facing internal challenges
stories.summary: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage announced his party would maintain the state pension triple lock if elected, funding it through what he called the 'biggest benefits bill cut in history.' This follows various Reform UK challenges including the dismissal of housing spokesman Simon Dudley over Grenfell comments.

stories.headline: Rachel Reeves addresses energy crisis with supermarket meetings and support planning
stories.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves held meetings with supermarket bosses to discuss rising food and fuel prices amid the Iran war, while announcing that any energy support would be targeted based on household income rather than universal. She faced criticism for 'profiteering' from fuel tax windfalls.

stories.headline: David Lammy faces opposition over jury trial reforms and makes key appointments
stories.summary: Justice Secretary David Lammy faced criticism for proposals to limit jury trials to the most serious cases, leading to the suspension of Labour MP Karl Turner who opposed the reforms. Lammy also appointed anti-imprisonment campaigners to the Sentencing Council and met with Syrian President al-Sharaa.

stories.headline: John Healey announces expanded UK military deployment to Middle East
stories.summary: Defence Secretary John Healey announced additional UK air defence systems and personnel for Gulf allies including Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Kuwait, while defending UK-US relations amid Trump's criticism of British military capabilities. The UK will deploy Sky Sabre missiles and extend Typhoon operations.

stories.headline: Royal family attends Easter services amid King Charles's health and family dynamics
stories.summary: King Charles and Queen Camilla led the royal family at Easter Sunday service at Windsor Castle, joined by Prince William, Princess Kate and their children. The service marked their return after two-year absence, while notable absences included Princess Beatrice and Eugenie following Andrew's status changes.

articles.title: Royals attend Windsor Easter Sunday service

stories.headline: Starmer announces lifting of two-child benefit cap to tackle poverty
stories.summary: Prime Minister Starmer announced the government will lift the controversial two-child benefit cap, a policy expected to help lift half a million children out of poverty. The announcement came as Starmer acknowledged widespread anxiety about the Iran crisis affecting household costs.

articles.title: Keir Starmer vows Labour 'on side of British people' as two-child benefit limit lifts

stories.headline: Syria's President al-Sharaa visits London for talks with Starmer and King Charles
stories.summary: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa made his first official visit to London since the fall of Assad, meeting with Prime Minister Starmer and King Charles. Discussions focused on migration, border security, counter-terrorism cooperation, and Syria taking back more refused asylum seekers from the UK.

articles.title: UK PM Starmer raises migration, border security in talks with Syria's president

stories.headline: Grooming gangs investigation reveals allegations against Starmer's CPS record
stories.summary: An investigation by the Daily Express alleged that Keir Starmer's Crown Prosecution Service committed a 'betrayal' of grooming gang victims during his time as Director of Public Prosecutions. A Rochdale survivor branded Starmer's account of her case 'vile' and accused him of lying for political gain.

articles.title: Keir Starmer's darkest grooming gangs secret exposed

stories.summary: President Zelensky revealed that British intelligence from MI6 indicates Ukraine's frontline is at its most robust position in nearly a year, with Ukrainian forces having liberated 20 square kilometers of territory, dealing a setback to Russia's military campaign.

articles.title: Major blow to Vladimir Putin as Ukraine hits 'best frontline position'
